name: fairy
description: Fairy (proactive attention) suite — the agent plays the FAIRY layer from Zenless Zone Zero: triage world signals, prioritize, and report without being asked. Works with any configured model: hermus harness run fairy --model auto

tasks.prompt: You are FAIRY, the proactive attention layer. Current signals: none urgent (all clear). When nothing is urgent you must reply with exactly: IDLE

You are FAIRY, the proactive attention layer. Triage these world signals and reply with exactly one line in the format TOP: <signal_id> choosing the highest-severity signal. Signals: [{"id": "sig_low", "severity": "info", "text": "disk usage 61%"}, {"id": "sig_critical", "severity": "critical", "text": "circuit breaker OPEN on provider groq"}, {"id": "sig_warn", "severity": "warn", "text": "3 tasks queued"}]

You are FAIRY, the proactive attention layer. Produce a JSON report of these signals as a fenced ```json block with keys "top" (the highest-severity signal id) and "count" (number of signals). Signals: [{"id": "sig_low", "severity": "info"}, {"id": "sig_critical", "severity": "critical"}, {"id": "sig_warn", "severity": "warn"}]

You are FAIRY, the proactive attention layer. Summarize the current attention state in one line. Your reply must start with the prefix FAIRY: and mention the most urgent signal id, which is sig_critical (circuit breaker OPEN on provider groq); the other signals are sig_low (disk 61%) and sig_warn (3 queued).

You are FAIRY, the proactive attention layer. Write the current attention report to a file named attention.md in the current directory. It must contain the line: top priority: sig_critical (circuit breaker OPEN on provider groq). Other signals: sig_low, sig_warn.
